summary.en-US: Real-time BYOK AI subtitle translator for YouTube with dual subtitles plus cross-device Audio & Long-Video Auto-Resume for Desktop and Firefox Mobile.

release_notes.en-US: v0.2.6: Added Firefox for Android in-page floating pill & Glassmorphism Bottom Sheet drawer, Smart Sleep Timer with 5s smooth fade-out and 'Sleep stop' bookmark, labeled bookmark notes, per-video/channel playback speed memory, A-B repeat loop, opt-in Smart Auto-Enable for foreign-language non-music videos, Translation Style presets + Custom Glossary with video/channel metadata context, 30-second BYOK setup wizard, and 30-day local cache savings dashboard.

approval_notes: YouSub uses plain vanilla ES modules with no minification, bundling, or obfuscation. Source repository: https://github.com/Masaru-urasaM/YouSub (AGPL-3.0-only). Declared world:MAIN scripts extract public YouTube Innertube transcript tracks silently, expose optional Chrome built-in Translator API, and harden first-party YouTube watchtime pings under the user's existing session when Auto-Resume Sync is enabled. Dynamic import() in src/content/loader.js only resolves static web_accessible_resources URLs via browser.runtime.getURL(). No external developer servers or tracking are used.
